The best restaurant in Vietnam so far! We came here for both lunch and dinner. All the food we ordered tasted delicious and the portions are huge. For lunch, we have the stir fried chicken with vegetables and rice. The veggies were so sweet and cooked just right with generous amount of chicken. We also got the noodles with tofu, crunchy mushrooms and soy sauce.
Service was amazing! The owner was very friendly and service was fast. We did not mind waiting for the food because they served the drinks ahead. Set was cool too, all the tables and chairs were facing the street. Come visit here if you're in Ninh Bình, you won't be disappointed.
